verdict.rationale: Sai is itself the built-in AI assistant. Users describe work in plain English, and Sai carries it out on a cloud computer or their own device, asking for approval before sensitive steps. It works across desktop apps, browsers, file systems and terminals, and keeps running after the user leaves. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, since all evidence is vendor-claimed docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: you describe the work in plain English and Sai does it on a cloud computer or your own device, asking for approval before sensitive steps.
Sai works across your entire operating system: desktop apps, web browsers, file systems, and terminals, the way a human would.
Sai continues after you close the laptop. Get notified via iMessage and Telegram when it needs you.
